title: Day of Black Sun — Just cast day of black sun for X = 5, it should destroy all creatures with mana value 5 or less but…

Zero rejections; the spell resolved 'successfully' per the engine while destroying nothing, matching the triage (tracked-set #0 published empty by the continuous-effect head).
